name: reading-mode-theme-changer
description: Switch the color theme automatically based on the active tab, using your own groups of file patterns and themes.

commands.title: Add Active File Type to a Group…
Show How the Active Tab Is Matched

readingModeTheme.enabled.description: Switch the color theme automatically based on the active tab.

readingModeTheme.groups.markdownDescription:
Theme groups, checked top to bottom; the first group with a matching file pattern decides the theme. [Edit groups in the settings panel](command:readingModeTheme.openSettings).

A pattern is a glob, optionally followed by `:editor`, `:preview` or `:any` (the default). Globs without a `/` match the file name; globs with a `/` match the path.

name.description: A label for this group, shown by the "Show How the Active Tab Is Matched" command.

theme.markdownDescription: The color theme to use: the name shown in the Color Theme picker (the value `workbench.colorTheme` takes).

targets.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, each optionally followed by `:editor`, `:preview` or `:any`.

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this group without deleting it.

readingModeTheme.fallbackTheme.markdownDescription: Theme used when no group matches. Leave empty to keep the current theme.

readingModeTheme.debounceMs.description: Wait this many milliseconds after a tab change before switching themes. Avoids flicker when VS Code briefly reports another tab as active.

readingModeTheme.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the matched group in the status bar. Click it to open the settings panel.
